text.description_html:
First Impressions RD-MT-1x2.5 Modern Door Stop

Very clean looking modern floor mount door stop (door bumper) that is easy to install. Includes the mounting screw.

This door stop is mounted to the floor, allowing the bottom of the door to contact it. If using near a wall, you want to mount the stop in a position so that the rubber bumper contacts the door before the door knob touches the wall.

Specifications for First Impressions FII-RDMT-1x2-US15 Door Stop

  • Overall Height: 2-1/2"
  • Height of Rubber from Floor: 2-1/16"
  • Rubber Bumper Color: Black
  • Diameter: 1"
  • Material: Aluminum
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Includes Mounting Hardware

*Sold Individually.
